scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with tall buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of old and new architecture, including a large beige building with many windows and balconies on the right side of the street, and a modern glass-fronted building on the left side. The street is lined with trees and has a median strip with plants and a tree in the middle. A white van drives down the street, while pedestrians walk along the sidewalk. The sky is partly cloudy with some blue patches.
scene_analysis.buildings: The beige building has a curved corner and is several stories high, with a flat roof and a decorative cornice. It has a mix of rectangular and arched windows, and a few balconies. The building on the left is made of dark glass and steel, with a more modern design. There are also several other buildings in the distance, including a tall, narrow building with a pointed roof.
scene_analysis.materials: The beige building has a smooth, cream-colored facade with a few decorative elements, such as carved stone carvings and ornate ironwork. The glass-fronted building has a sleek, modern design with large panes of glass and metal framing. The street is paved with asphalt and has a smooth, even texture.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and planters along the sidewalk, as well as a few trash cans and recycling bins. There are also several streetlights and traffic signals, including a pedestrian crossing signal.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The median strip is lined with small trees and shrubs, and there are several larger trees along the sidewalk. The trees have bare branches and appear to be deciduous.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs along the street, including a large sign reading 'Eixample' in bold letters. There are also several smaller signs indicating street names and directions.
